Itinerary

Visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, followed by a Kandy city tour

Explore Ramboda Waterfall

Visit a Tea Factory and Tea Estate

Stroll through Victoria Park

Enjoy Gregory Lake

Visit Hakgala Botanical Garden

Visit Waterfalls & Turtle Hatchery

Arrival at Colombo International Airport and transfer to the hotel.

Visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, followed by a Kandy city tour, Gem Museum, and a traditional Cultural Dance Show.

Explore Ramboda Waterfall, visit a Tea Factory and Tea Estate, stroll through Victoria Park, enjoy Gregory Lake, and visit Hakgala Botanical Garden.

Visit St. Clair’s Falls, Devon Falls, and the Sea Turtle Hatchery.

Relax in Bentota, enjoy final moments by the beach, and transfer for departure.
